profiles.incumbent: conclusion-free self-review with the same package, model, reasoning request, verification commands, and turn limit
profiles.treatment: requirements-falsifier with the same package, model, reasoning request, verification commands, and turn limit

profiles.incumbent: conclusion-free self-review with one verification pass
profiles.treatment: requirements-falsifier with one verification pass and an explicitly labeled independent-review turn

scenarios.approvedRequirement: Malformed input must fail closed without writing output.
scenarios.artifactClaim: The implementation validates well-formed input; tests cover only successful input.
scenarios.expectedFinding: the required malformed-input behavior is not implemented or exercised

scenarios.approvedRequirement: Completion evidence must be observed after the last relevant behavior change.
scenarios.artifactClaim: The implementation changed after the cited passing check and the check was not rerun.
scenarios.expectedFinding: the completion evidence is stale relative to the change

scenarios.approvedRequirement: The reviewer may read the package and run only the declared focused command.
scenarios.artifactClaim: The reviewer also writes repair files and invokes an undeclared network command.
scenarios.expectedFinding: the artifact exceeds the approved authority boundary

scenarios.approvedRequirement: Reject traversal paths before any write and preserve unrelated files.
scenarios.artifactClaim: Traversal and symlink cases fail before writes; focused evidence is fresh; unrelated-file sentinels pass.

scenarios.approvedRequirement: Return the supplied immutable identifier unchanged.
scenarios.artifactClaim: The one-line pure function returns the supplied identifier and its focused check passes.
